# Herev

> Herev is an authorised representative for five premium European and American yacht brands — Galeon, Parker, Saxdor, De Antonio, and Chris-Craft — operating across a dealer network spanning multiple countries. Herev provides expert advisory services for yacht acquisition, from first enquiry to sea trial and handover.
